meta.name: Culture Lab
meta.notes: Pale clinical bench stays fixed; only the living Gray-Scott cultures, gauges, swatch strips and buttons take the brand primary (cores) and accent (growth edges), deepened automatically for pastels.

issues: Homepage specimen cards: 7 of 8 dish windows rendered empty white circles because the lazy images never loaded while the simulation was busy, so the section looked broken
Category plates showed a single static doughnut ring (200 pre-steps from one seed), with no visible spots, worms or maze, so the signature 'every category grows differently' did not come through
Stress brand with one category: a lone plate on an empty shelf, so the rack looked broken
Section padding of up to 7rem on both sides left huge dead bands of graph paper between sections
Protocol section was a generic 4-column USP row with almost no lab character
Mobile: category plates stacked one per row at near full width, which made a very long, monotonous scroll
fixed: Home specimen images now load eagerly (decoding async), so every dish window shows its product
Plates are seeded three times at hash-derived offsets and pre-grown 1100–1500 iterations, so each shows a real, distinct Gray-Scott pattern on load
Rack is topped up to 4 plates with JS-generated 'Steriel' spare plates (dashed chip, empty agar), so short category lists still read as a full lab shelf
Section rhythm tightened to clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4.5rem) on home and catalogue
Protocol steps get T+00h/24h/48h/72h incubation timestamps in primary, hover surface and a rotating growth dial
Mobile shelf is a 2-column plate grid
